top_signals.title: Ecobank Taps Yuan Payments as It Eyes Africa’s Trade With China
top_signals.summary: Ecobank Transnational Inc. is stepping up efforts to facilitate direct yuan payments for clients trading with China as the pan-African lender seeks to boost ties with the continent’s biggest trading partner and reduce reliance on the dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Australia to Release Final Plan to Keep More LNG Output at Home
top_signals.summary: Australia is set to unveil the final version of a controversial plan to force liquefied natural gas producers to reserve as much as a fifth of their output for local buyers.
